column1: # <corpus text>\t<reason>: espeak-ng es_list irregular pronunciations our rules intentionally do not match

column2: espeak-ng es_list number words join tens, y and ones into one unstressed word (oʧɛntaikwˈatɾo)
espeak-ng reads unpronounceable vowel-initial acronyms as words (ˈadn, ˈibm); we spell them (aðeˈene, iβeˈeme)
